data.name: Hormones of the Dead
data.detailed_description:
Over 90% of the human population became zombies within the first day of the zombie apocalypse.

All hope seemed lost for the survivors but then a mysterious website started to spread on social media.

People who visited the website could gain magical powers but when Prim visited the website it simply instructed her to kill herself.

Hormones of the Dead is an Action RPG about a trans woman who finds herself in a death loop inside a Walgreens Pharmacy. Every time she dies she can go to the afterlife and trade the souls of the dead for powerups, weapons, familiars, and stat gains. 

Will she remain trapped in a time loop of endless death or can she defeat the zombies and walk out alive?!

data.short_description: Prim is a trans woman trying to survive the zombie apocalypse. All she wants are her hormones, all the zombies want is to turn her into one of them. Can Prim remain herself? Hormones of the Dead is a ZOMBIE ACTION RPG by Taylor Mccue!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel or AMD
  • Graphics: Graphics Card or Integrated Graphics
  • Additional Notes: Should run on many PCs made after 2010

content_descriptors.notes:
This game takes place in a zombie apocalypse. 

Please expect bubblegum cartoonish gore. Expect at worst what you'd see in an 80s horror movie.
Some characters may make sexual or offensive comments.
